item_specifications.material: Deluxe Shower Kit & Garden Hose Attachment (Variable Pressure)

about_item: INNOVATIVE BRUSH DESIGN: No more getting soaked! Our patented rubber splash shield and bath hose attachment will keep you dry as you groom and massage your dog. It's the ultimate choice in grooming comfort for both you and your pet.

PRESSURE CONTROL VALVE: The deluxe kit comes with an adjustable water pressure valve. You can control how fast you want the water to come out! Bathe, brush, rinse, start and stop with one hand while also controlling water pressure.
EASY FOR YOU & YOUR DOG: Baths are a great time for you and your dog to bond. Our massaging brush will feel great on your dog as you clean that messy fur. Enjoy a stress-free and enjoyable bath time!

GREAT FOR ALL AGES: Ergonomic and easy to use, this handheld shower attachment leaves you with an extra hand free, so you can comfort your pet while bathing them. Reach all four paws with the extra-long eight-foot hose. Plus, it's easy to use for all ages!

PACKAGE DETAILS: This grooming kit comes with the patented chrome Wondurdog shower brush head and splash shield, an 8-foot flexible stainless-steel hose, suction cup holder for shower wall, a 3-way shower diverter to easy click from human shower to dog bathing station.

summary.text: Customers find this dog shower head to be of high quality, easy to install, and appreciate that it's easier than using cups of water to wash their pets. Moreover, the adjustable water pressure and functionality receive positive feedback, and customers consider it well worth the price. Additionally, they like its cleansing capabilities, with one customer noting how the brush-like bristles help clean through thick hair. However, customers disagree on whether the shower head is leak-proof.

authors_reviews.title: Great product for the price; a must have for large dog breed owners.
authors_reviews.text: Awesome product! I was able to install and use the same day with absolutely no problems. My GSD is skittish of baths, but I was able to bathe her in a timely fashion without stressing her out. Overall it made bath time bearable for her and easier for me. If you have a large dog I would consider this a must have.Pros:Easy to installLooks decentEasy to useInexpensive; when you consider grooming cost out of the home (one trip is already over the price of this kit), or even those wash your dog yourself places (two trips and I’m already over the cost of the kit).Cons:The surface is shiny and prone to scratches when you use pliers to tighten. And you MUST use pliers. The instructions state as much. You cannot get a tight enough seal to avoid leaking around the threads without using them. HOWEVER, the leaking is minimal and does not hamper the use of the shower head or dog wash, so if you didn’t want to use pliers you could do so.
authors_reviews.author: C. Berry

authors_reviews.title: Makes bath time easy!
authors_reviews.text: This is absolutely the best shower attachment I’ve tried for my dogs. Easy to use, flips easily between shower head and attachment. I did have a plumber install and have had no problems with leakage. It is easy to adjust water pressure and my dogs seem to like the rubber grooming brush, leaning into it during rinses.
authors_reviews.author: Four O’Clock wishes

authors_reviews.title: Game Changer
authors_reviews.text: I can finally groom my dogs! I have two Portuguese Water Dogs and have struggled for years trying to groom them at home due to a lack of quality equipment. You can't go wrong with this item! The long hose with the sprayer works perfectly. The sprayer is beyond practical and is a luxury compared to my past grooming attemps at wetting and rinsing. The sprayer has an on/off spray tab and a water pressure dial. The brush-like bristles help clean through the dogs thick curls while soothing my dogs with its pseudo massage.Installation was a breeze. I attach hose directly to my shower outlet for grooming, and remove once done until next time. You have to use new plumbers tape every time after removing the old plumbers tape. I hand tighten every time and experience no leaks.The hose and sprayer are made of quality material. I expect to use this for years on end.
authors_reviews.author: Alecia

authors_reviews.title: Very good product but shipping issue?
authors_reviews.text: Just used this today on my 35 pound baby boy and omg it’s so awesome! So much easier than using cups of water to wash him. I love that there are two adjusters on the nozzle; one for water pressure and an on/off switch so you don’t waste a bunch of water. This product is very well made. No issues with leaking or anything. The only reason why I’m giving 4 stars is because they don’t ship to my zip code. I had to have them ship it to my mom in Vegas and I picked it up while visiting her. I live in Los Angeles, so you would think they could ship here, but no. Thankfully I have my mom in Vegas, but if I didn’t have her, I would not have been able to get this product.
authors_reviews.author: Chloe

authors_reviews.title: Where has this been all my life?!?!!
authors_reviews.text: This product is AMAZING! I live in an apartment with two 100+ pounds American bulldogs. There is a dog wash run that is filthy and I've stopped taking my dogs to it to bathe them in a tub filled with mildew, feces, etc. The shower heads inside the apartment are attached, so it makes it really hard to get a good rinse especially underneath my boys. I've been using a plastic cup and splashing their bellies to rinse and it's been a nightmare and baths take way too long. But not anymore! This thing saves me so much time! And it's so easy to install and use. My back would be in so much pain before, but now I barely have to bend over. And I can tell the dogs are so much happier not being blasted by a shower head to the face from 6 feet above them. I am so glad I bought this! Genius!!
authors_reviews.author: I. Green

authors_reviews.title: Finally, a dog washer that works.
authors_reviews.text: Installed in 8 minutes and washing the dog in 10 minutes. I has the power I need for the big dog and then I adjust the flow with one hand and wash the small dog. Very impressed and seems like great quality. I really like the one handed operation and they like the massage end.
